title: valeriana calvescens
intro: Valeriana calvescens, commonly known as Mountain Valerian, is a species of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include anxiety and insomnia relief, improved sleep quality, and reduced stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Valerian include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Valeriana calvescens include valerenic acid, isovalerenic acid, and valepotriates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
